They argue that observed difference is confounded, not due to sex. They do challenge premise. They do not provide biological mechanism. They show that treatment arm has lower response rates overall, and that severity confounds. They also note that raw comparison is misleading. They do not quantify a small gap and then give biological explanation. They do show that difference does not favor women; they say within treatment arm, females 62.2% vs males 65.1% (men higher). So they satisfy (b). They challenge premise. So pass.
